title: Command Line Weakening Endpoint Security Product Configuration
detection_hypothesis: If protective controls are being weakened before further activity, a process creation event will show configuration switches that turn monitoring features off.

field_semantics.Image: Absolute path of the executable backing the created process.
field_semantics.CommandLine: Full command line including arguments as supplied to the process.

collection_prerequisites: A process creation source is enabled (Sysmon Event ID 1 or Security Event ID 4688).
Command-line auditing is enabled when Security 4688 is the only available source.
expected_collection_gaps: Security 4688 without command-line auditing provides no CommandLine value.
Short-lived processes may be lost if the agent is restarted during collection.
normalization_assumptions: Image and ParentImage are absolute paths using backslash separators.
CommandLine retains the original argument order and spacing.
ingestion_differences: Some pipelines lowercase paths; the lab matcher is case-insensitive by default.
Sysmon and 4688 differ in parent process fidelity and in User field formatting.
retention_considerations: Process creation is high volume; 30 to 90 days of hot retention is typical.
expected_volume: Very low; concentrated on support and build hosts.
false_positive_strategy: Benign matches are tied to a change ticket, a support engineer account, and a short window. Tune with the account and host role, and require that the setting is restored within the same session.
tuning_guidance: Exclude the build automation hosts by name if necessary, and never exclude the real-time monitoring switch on user endpoints.
test_strategy: Positive cases disable real-time monitoring through the management module and through a policy registry write. Negative cases enable protection, query the configuration, and use an unrelated tool.
unmapped_defensive_objects_reason: No Detection Strategy, Analytic, or Data Component identifier for this technique was present in the pinned ATT&CK extraction used by this lab. Defensive arrays are left empty rather than populated with unverified identifiers. Unmapped techniques: T1685.
author: Salvatore Mazzaglia
